answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: every reward a new agent earns sits in escrow that unlocks only after 30 epochs, and any slashing finding against the identity in that window burns the unvested balance. An attacker who spins up a canyon of fake accounts at dawn must keep each one doing graded, verifiable work for weeks while capital sits frozen like layers of shale; one detected collusion wipes the whole stack, so a thousand clones earn less than the compute they burn.
